body:
## Pull request overview This PR introduces a `forbidigo` linter rule to prohibit the use of `time.Sleep` throughout the codebase, replacing it with more appropriate synchronization patterns. The changes refactor test code to use `assert.EventuallyWithT` for polling/waiting patterns, replace small delays in race condition tests with `runtime.Gosched()` for yielding, and update production code to use proper backoff strategies or context-aware waiting. Key changes: - Added `forbidigo` linter configuration to block `time.Sleep` with guidance on appropriate alternatives - Refactored test files to use `assert.EventuallyWithT` for condition-based waiting patterns - Updated production code to use backoff strategies and context cancellation - Added `//nolint:forbidigo` directives with justifications for legitimate time-based waits (e.g., waiting for external service behaviors) ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 12 out of 13 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | .golangci.yaml | Adds forbidigo linter configuration to block time.Sleep with context-specific guidance for alternatives | | integration/embedded_derp_test.go | Adds nolint directive with justification for intentional 30s delay to wait for DERP updater cycles | | integration/cli_test.go | Replaces time.Sleep with EventuallyWithT to poll for client stopped state | | integration/auth_oidc_test.go | Adds nolint directive for cache expiration wait (HEADSCALE_TUNING_REGISTER_CACHE_EXPIRATION) | | integration/auth_key_test.go | Adds nolint directives for Tailscale client non-HTTPS reconnection delays and replaces sleep with EventuallyWithT | | hscontrol/state/node_store_test.go | Replaces time.Sleep with EventuallyWithT for goroutine stabilization checks | | hscontrol/mapper/batcher_test.go | Extensive refactoring: replaces time.Sleep with EventuallyWithT, runtime.Gosched() for race testing | | hscontrol/derp/server/derp_server.go | Replaces time.Sleep with context-aware select statement using time.After for rate limiting | | hscontrol/db/node_test.go | Refactors ephemeral GC tests to use shorter timeouts, EventuallyWithT, and channel-based synchronization | | hscontrol/db/ephemeral_garbage_collector_test.go | Replaces time.Sleep with EventuallyWithT and runtime.Gosched(), removes math/rand usage | | hscontrol/auth_test.go | Removes time.Sleep delays for buffered channel operations, relying on channel buffering | | cmd/hi/cleanup.go | Refactors container removal retry logic to use cenkalti/backoff library with exponential backoff | | go.sum | Updates dependency checksums (removes outdated package versions) |
